About this space
Escape to our delightful wooden cabin, perfectly nestled among majestic msasa trees and stunning granite outcrops.

Step into the sunlounge and soak in the views over the pristine miombo forest, where you can unwind and enjoy a morning coffee while listening to the symphony of nature.

The towering granite monoliths of Susurumba guard this tranquil retreat, providing a breathtaking backdrop for your stay.

Hiking the trails starts at your front door followed by evenings in front of the fire.

The space
Three bedrooms, two with queen beds and one with two singles.
Mainroom has ensuite.
Solar system keeps the lights and plugs on at all times and stove has gas and electric options.
Sunlounge and main lounge areas with great outdoor area for eating with ready to go braai facilities.
